BrochureContent.Content:
Don’t miss this opportunity to acquire a two bedroom home ideally located in Swords Town Centre with all amenities on your doorstep. Set on a generous corner site, this property offers excellent potential. There is a walled front garden with driveway for off street parking. Seatown Villas is a mature and sought after residential development in the heart of Swords. The bright accommodation extends to approx. 75 sq.m. and comprises entrance hall, guest wc, dual aspect living room and dual aspect kitchen/dining room. Upstairs there are two double bedrooms and bathroom. Viewing is highly recommended.

* Town Centre Location with all amenities on your doorstep
* Generous corner site offering excellent potential
* Sunny, West facing private rear garden
* Driveway for off street parking
* Mature & sought after development
* Not overlooked to the front
* Gas fired central heating
* Double glazed windows
* Bright, dual aspect living room & kitchen
* No management fees
* Walking distance to Swords Main Street, Pavillions Shopping Centre, Schools, Swords Business Park and Bus routes including Dublin Bus & Swords Express 
* Easy access to Dublin Airport, Airside Retail Park, M1 & M50 motorways 
* Enjoy scenic walks along the close by Estuary between Swords and Malahide 
* Within close proximity to Fingallians GAA Club, Balheary Park, Swords Town Park, Malahide Rugby Club and Swords Sailing & Boating Club 
* Schools within walking distance: 
St Colmcilles Primary Schools
The Old Borough National School 
St. Finian's Community College 
Fingal Community College 
Colaiste Choilm Secondary School

OUTSIDE:
To the front there is a walled garden with lawn. The sunny, West facing, private rear garden features patio and block built shed
